# bintables/binop

> Helper for binary operators: left operand in rax, right operand in rbx.

truck [bintables](../bintables.md) · [source](../../../registry/bintables/binop.pkg)

Not a language construct: arithmetic and comparison packages include it with
`@binop` when their right operand is not simple. The left operand is
evaluated first and saved on the stack while the right one is evaluated.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
{left}
push rax
{right}
mov rbx, rax
pop rax
```

## Used by

[bintables/add](add.md), [bintables/div](div.md), [bintables/eq](eq.md), [bintables/ge](ge.md), [bintables/gt](gt.md), [bintables/le](le.md), [bintables/lt](lt.md), [bintables/mod](mod.md), [bintables/mul](mul.md), [bintables/ne](ne.md), [bintables/sub](sub.md)
